key_insight: Agents-K1 shifts research agents from abstract-only retrieval to full-paper, agent-native scientific knowledge orchestration with structured entities, evidence, and relations.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical pipeline for building scalable scientific KGs and retrieval systems that support multi-hop reasoning across large paper corpora.
method: Multimodal parser extracts entities, claims, evidence, citations, and typed relations from full papers.
4B IE backbone is trained with GRPO using a rule-based reward.
Graphanything CLI unifies web search, multimodal graph retrieval, and cross-document traversal.
evidence_signal: The authors process 2.46 million papers across six subjects to build Scholar-KG and report superior performance on scientific IE, KG construction, and multi-hop reasoning.
watch_item: The system’s quality may depend on parser robustness and schema alignment, so extraction errors could propagate through the graph and retrieval pipeline.
